question: Who are victorious among consciousness-bliss teachers?
premises: Teachers descended from Somananda and Utpala are victorious.
Their compositions spread in all directions.
inference: The verse praises the victorious lineage of Somananda and Utpala.
plain_english: Victorious are those descended from Shri Somananda, Bodha, and Shrimad Utpala, whose consciousness-bliss compositions spread in all directions.
